reports.agriculturalContext: Actual farmer paddy-field composite soil sampling, Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh; NF and Non-NF plots are separate.

extractionScope.description: Extract only the GRL row and NF (Natural Farming) column in chemical tables IV(a), IV(b), IV(c), source PDF pages 122–123 (retained pages 3–4). Return its twelve chemical readings as one selected plot/sample. Retained pages 1–2 provide sampling and methods context. Other village rows, Non-NF columns and the microbial table are not selected; do not mix or extract them.

limitations: Published measured agricultural-field soil analysis; not a government-issued individual Soil Health Card or a measurement of the demo field or any user farm.
Unmodified original PDF pages 54,120,122,123 are retained with sampling and laboratory-method context.

The full tables contain multiple paired farm plots. Only the explicitly selected GRL / NF plot and twelve chemical readings are in this reference extraction scope; this is not a complete-table extraction.
Collection is reported as April–May 2019 and publication as July 2020; exact collection/report days are not supplied and must remain null.
No pH or electrical conductivity reading is published in the selected chemical tables; missing parameters must not be invented.
Available nitrogen is described in the source as Kjeldahl method (with its cited reference); retain the source wording rather than silently substituting a different extraction method.
P and K chemical forms and unit labels must be retained as published, without conversion between elemental and oxide forms.
Other NF/Non-NF plots and the microbial table must remain separate and unselected.
No field nutrient dose or universal fertility rating is inferred from this reference.
reports.retirementReason: Replaced by the user-provided farm sample.
